text.tspan: 1. The system should give options like get, set, delete, TTL, etc.
2. Eviction should be TTL as well as LRU.
1. Low latency on get operations (milliseconds response time).
2. Highly scalable (adding and removing nodes should be easier).
Cache servers can have Highly Available servers
TTL for expiry and remove expired keys before
LRU logic to keep unexpired safe.
If no expired key, remove least recently used.
Each key when accessed (get or set), pop it up
on top, leaving unaccessed at bottom, so LRU
